title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Grotle Wild Force 072/071 Art Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The 2024 Near Mint Pokemon Grotle 072/071 AR Wild Force SV5K Japanese card is a highly sought-after collectible for fans of the Pokemon Trading Card Game. This Full Art Pokemon card features the character Grotle in a stunning illustration, crafted from durable card stock materials. With a rarity level of Art Rare and sourced from Japan, this card is a valuable addition to any collector's deck. Produced by Nintendo and illustrated by Oswaldo KATO, this Japanese-language card is sure to delight fans of all ages with its unique design and rarity.
